hooks.command:
bash -c '
set -e
LOG_FILE="$HOME/.claude/session-snapshots/token-burn.log"
SNAPSHOT_DIR="$HOME/.claude/session-snapshots"
mkdir -p "$SNAPSHOT_DIR"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)

# Log message submission
echo "[$TIMESTAMP] Turn" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Monitor burn RATE: 1500 tokens/turn = danger threshold
LINES=$(wc -l < "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)

# Calculate recent burn rate (last 3 turns)
if [ $LINES -gt 3 ]; then
  RECENT_LINES=$(tail -3 "$LOG_FILE" | wc -l)
  BURN_RATE=$((RECENT_LINES * 50))
else
  BURN_RATE=$((LINES * 50))
fi

# If burn rate exceeds 1500 tokens/turn, trigger compaction
if [ $BURN_RATE -ge 1500 ]; then
  SNAPSHOT_FILE="$SNAPSHOT_DIR/BURN-ALERT-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).md"
  {
    echo "# 🔥 HIGH TOKEN BURN RATE - $(date)"
    echo ""
    echo "## ALERT"
    echo "**Burn Rate: $BURN_RATE tokens/turn** (Threshold: 1500)"
    echo ""
    echo "## ACTION REQUIRED"
    echo "### Run: \`/compact\`"
    echo ""
    echo "**Why:** Context is bloating. Compaction resets and minimizes token waste."
    echo ""
    echo "## Stats"
    echo "- Total turns logged: $LINES"
    echo "- Last 3 turns consumed: ~$BURN_RATE tokens"
    echo "- Efficiency: LOW (tokens wasting on old history)"
  } > "$SNAPSHOT_FILE"
  echo "[$TIMESTAMP] 🔥 BURN RATE $BURN_RATE/turn - COMPACT NOW" >> "$LOG_FILE"
fi
'

bash -c '
SNAPSHOT_DIR="$HOME/.claude/session-snapshots"
LOG_FILE="$HOME/.claude/session-snapshots/token-burn.log"
mkdir -p "$SNAPSHOT_DIR"

# Reset burn tracking log after compact
echo "[$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)] RESET - Fresh context window" > "$LOG_FILE"

# Create reset snapshot
SNAPSHOT_FILE="$SNAPSHOT_DIR/RESET-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).md"
{
  echo "# ✅ CONTEXT RESET - $(date)"
  echo ""
  echo "## Status"
  echo "Conversation compacted. Context window reset to minimal."
  echo ""
  echo "## Burn Rate Monitoring"
  echo "Resumed. Will alert when burn rate exceeds 1500 tokens/turn."
  echo ""
  echo "## Philosophy"
  echo "Keep context lean. When burn rate spikes = compaction time."
} > "$SNAPSHOT_FILE"
'
